meta.title: Australia V5 — Brisbane, Noosa, Hamilton Island & Sydney, December 2027
meta.dates: Dec 14, 2027 – Jan 2, 2028 (FLL → Dallas → Brisbane · Australia Zoo · Noosa · Hamilton Island · Sydney for NYE · home Jan 2)

blocks.title: Arrive FLL, check bags
blocks.detail:
3 hrs ahead for an international itinerary with a family of 4.
Departs Fort Lauderdale, not Miami.
Swimsuits, hats and sun shirts in the carry-ons — landing day goes straight to a pool.

blocks.title: American Airlines AA1373 - FLL → DFW - Nonstop - ~3h15m
blocks.detail:
FLL → DFW, Economy, 4 passengers.
Lands ~7:40 PM Central (8:40 PM Eastern).
Segment times derived from the 22h 5m total and 2h 1m connection — confirm when booking.
blocks.notes: First leg of one connecting itinerary. Points and cash for the whole trip are logged on the DFW → BNE leg.

blocks.title: Layover at DFW
blocks.detail: 2h 1m connection. Dinner in the terminal before the 17-hour leg.
blocks.notes: ~$60 for the family in the terminal.

blocks.title: American Airlines AA7 - DFW → BNE - Nonstop - ~16h49m
blocks.detail:
DFW → BNE, Economy, 4 passengers.
Crosses the International Date Line — Wednesday Dec 15 disappears in flight.
Lands 6:30 AM Thursday Dec 16, Brisbane time (AEST, UTC+10, no daylight saving; 15 hrs ahead of Florida).
Total itinerary 22h 5m.
blocks.flag:
Departs FLL, not MIA — plan the drive up and parking, or price a MIA-origin option.
Apply for each traveller's Australian ETA (official 'Australian ETA' app) before departure — not issued on arrival.
Dates moved to Tue Dec 14 — re-search this routing for Dec 14, 2027 when award space opens (~Jan 2027).
blocks.notes:
• Placeholder from a real search of this routing for Tue Dec 8, 2026.
• Alaska Atmos Rewards: 42,500 pts + $50.10 per person → 170,000 pts + $200.40 for four. Booking class T, 9 seats.
• Same itinerary via American AAdvantage: 35,000 pts + $30.10 per person → 140,000 pts + $120.40 (30k fewer points, $80 less cash).
• Award inventory for Dec 14, 2027 opens roughly Dec 2026–Jan 2027 — re-search then.

days.title: Arrive Brisbane — Kangaroo Point Cliffs, river cruise, Riverbar dinner

blocks.title: Arrive BNE — immigration, bags, biosecurity
blocks.detail:
SmartGate for adult US e-passports; kids use the staffed lane with a parent.
Declare any food. Don't carry fruit or snacks off the plane.
75 min gate-to-curb for a family with checked bags — includes a bathroom stop before the rental desk.

blocks.title: Rental car pickup — BNE International terminal rental desks
blocks.detail:
Mid-size SUV from a major brand (Hertz / Avis / Budget / Europcar / Sixt — all have desks in the International terminal arrivals hall; the cars are in the adjacent rental carpark).
One booster seat for the 6-year-old (Queensland law: under 7 must be in an approved restraint). The 8-year-old may legally use the adult belt.
60 min allowed: queue, paperwork, fitting the booster, loading bags, finding the exit. Nothing else depends on this being fast.
blocks.notes:
ONE CAR FOR THE WHOLE TRIP:
• Thu Dec 16 7:45 AM → Thu Dec 23 ~9:45 AM = 8 rental days.
• ~AUD 120/day × 8 = AUD 960 + booster ~AUD 50 + tolls ~AUD 20 ≈ AUD 1,030 ≈ USD 670.
• Mid-December is the priciest month at BNE — re-quote ~6 months out; book on a free-cancellation rate for availability, not price.

WHAT IT DOES:
• Airport → Hyatt today (valet is free on a Globalist award stay).
• Hyatt → Australia Zoo → Noosa on Fri Dec 17, all Noosa errands, Noosa → BNE Domestic on Thu Dec 23.
• NOT the beach — every major brand's terms keep cars on sealed roads and void the insurance on sand. The one beach day is a separate 4WD delivered to the resort (see Dec 22).

blocks.title: Drive BNE → Hyatt Regency Brisbane
blocks.detail:
Airport Drive → Airport Link tunnel (toll, ~AUD 6) → Inner City Bypass → Queen St / Burnett Lane. ~17 km, 25 min at this hour.
Drive on the left. Jet-lagged — the passenger navigates, the driver only drives.
Valet at the hotel entrance takes the car; it stays with the valet until Sunday.
blocks.notes: • Toll billed to the rental's toll account.

blocks.title: Hyatt Regency Brisbane — valet takes the car, bell desk takes the bags
blocks.detail:
• 33 Burnett Lane (Queen St Mall), middle of the CBD. Category 3 World of Hyatt.
• Room is booked from Wed Dec 15, so it's ready on arrival — bags go straight up.
• Ask for the Deluxe Room, Multiple Beds (sleeps 4) or connecting rooms.
blocks.roomType: Standard room (or standard suite if available)
blocks.notes:
• Modeled at 12,000 pts/night × 2 = 24,000 (the Dec 15 night guarantees the room on arrival).
• Globalist early check-in is only subject to availability — the extra night is the only guarantee.
• Globalist: free valet on an award stay; breakfast for 2 adults + 2 kids.
blocks.flag: Email the hotel: arriving ~9 AM Dec 16 — keep the Dec 15 night held (don't treat as no-show).

blocks.title: Breakfast — Lennons (in the hotel)
blocks.detail:
• Straight down after the valet — breakfast before showers.
• Weekday breakfast 6:30–10:00 AM: seated by 9:30.
• Last meal until dinner — no lunch stop today.
blocks.notes: • Globalist benefit: breakfast for 2 adults + 2 kids included. AUD 0.
blocks.flag: Confirm with Lennons that a 9:30 seating can finish at ~10:10 (breakfast ends 10:00 on weekdays).

blocks.title: Back up to the room
blocks.detail: • Buffer: elevator, unpack the essentials.

blocks.title: Showers and change
blocks.detail: • 45 min for four people after a 22-hour journey.

blocks.title: Sunscreen, hats, day bag
blocks.detail:
• UV is Extreme by midday.
• Day bag: water bottles and snacks — no lunch stop until dinner at 5.

blocks.title: Walk to the City Botanic Gardens
blocks.detail: • ~800 m via Albert St to the Alice St gate.

blocks.title: City Botanic Gardens — riverside paths + playground
blocks.detail:
• Shaded paths under giant figs, mangrove boardwalk, playground.
• The Kangaroo Point Green Bridge starts at the Alice/Edward St corner of the gardens.

blocks.title: Cross the Kangaroo Point Green Bridge
blocks.detail:
• 470 m walking/cycling bridge over the river (opened Dec 2024).
• Story Bridge and Kangaroo Point Cliffs ahead.

blocks.title: Kangaroo Point Cliffs lookout
blocks.detail:
• The best free view of the city skyline and the river bend.
• Little shade at the top — keep it short.

blocks.title: Riverwalk to South Bank
blocks.detail:
• ~1.5–2 km, flat, along the riverfront past the Maritime Museum.
• 40 min at kid pace, including a water stop.

blocks.title: Wheel of Brisbane
blocks.detail:
• Enclosed, air-conditioned gondolas; ~15-min ride, 60 m up over South Bank.
• 40 min allowed for the queue.
blocks.notes:
ESTIMATE (third-party listing, not the operator's own page):
• ~AUD 20 adult × 2 + ~AUD 14 child × 2 = AUD 68 ≈ USD 44.
• Confirm current price and hours.

blocks.title: Walk to the Cultural Centre pontoon and board
blocks.detail:
• Public pontoon in front of the Queensland Museum / art gallery, South Bank boardwalk.
• Bathroom stop before boarding.

blocks.title: River City Cruises — Mid-Afternoon Sightseeing Cruise (anchor)
blocks.detail:
• 90 min, seated and covered, with commentary; licensed bar on board.
• Downriver past Kangaroo Point Cliffs, under the Story Bridge, out to New Farm and the Powerhouse.
blocks.notes:
VERIFIED (Visit Brisbane listing):
• Family (2 adults + 2 children 5–14) AUD 120 ≈ USD 78.
• Adult AUD 49, child AUD 22.
• Departs the Cultural Centre Public Pontoon, South Bank.
blocks.flag: Confirm the 2:30 PM departure runs on Thursdays in December, then book.

blocks.title: CityCat South Bank → Riverside
blocks.detail:
• ~600 m walk along the boardwalk to the South Bank CityCat terminal.
• Flat 50-cent fare per person (tap on with a card or phone).
• Short ride upriver past the CBD; 40 min absorbs one missed boat.

blocks.title: Riverfront boardwalk toward the Story Bridge
blocks.detail: • Eagle St riverwalk, right outside the restaurant.

blocks.title: Dinner — Riverbar & Kitchen, Eagle St
blocks.detail:
• Casual, on the river at Riparian Plaza (71 Eagle St), Story Bridge in view.
• Fish & chips, burgers, pizza, pasta; real kids' menu (12 and under).
• Kitchen open from 11:30 AM on Thursdays — book a deck table for 5:00.
blocks.notes:
PRICED FROM THE CURRENT MENU (Oct 2026):
• Beer-battered fish & chips AUD 35
• Riverbar cheeseburger with chips AUD 30
• 2 kids' meals (fish & chips / cheeseburger / ham & pineapple pizza / fettuccine) AUD 15 each
• = AUD 95 ≈ USD 62.

blocks.title: Walk back to the hotel
blocks.detail: • ~700 m up Creek St / Queen St.

blocks.title: Baths, pajamas — lights out by 7:15 PM
blocks.detail:
• Tomorrow's breakfast is 8:00 AM → back-at-hotel deadline 8:00 PM.
• Bags are already packed — nothing to repack tomorrow.

blocks.title: Breakfast — Lennons (in the hotel)
blocks.detail: • At 8:30, ask the valet for the car and the bell desk for the bags.
blocks.notes: • Globalist benefit: breakfast for 2 adults + 2 kids included. AUD 0.

blocks.title: Check out — car out front, bags loaded, booster in
Drive Hyatt → Australia Zoo, Beerwah
blocks.detail:
• Inner City Bypass → Gateway Motorway north (toll) → Bruce Highway (M1) → Steve Irwin Way exit (Glass House Mountains Tourist Route).
• ~80 km, ~1 hr with clear roads; 1h15 allowed for Friday traffic in Queensland school holidays.
• Bathroom stop at the highway service centre if needed.
blocks.notes: • Toll ~AUD 6 ≈ USD 3.90, billed to the rental's toll account.

blocks.title: Park and walk to the zoo gate
blocks.detail:
• Free on-site parking.
• In school holidays the car park to the gate can take 15–20 min.

blocks.title: Enter Australia Zoo — buy kangaroo food
blocks.detail:
• Family pass bought online beforehand (skips the ticket queue).
• Two bags of roo food at Guest Services or any gift shop.
• Zoo open 9 AM–5 PM daily.
blocks.notes:
VERIFIED (prices checked Oct 9, 2026):
• Family of 4 pass (2 adults + 2 children 3–14) AUD 233.95 ≈ USD 152.07.
• Roo food AUD 3 × 2 = AUD 6 ≈ USD 3.90.
• = USD 155.97.

blocks.title: Tigers LIVE! — Tiger Temple, 11:00 AM
blocks.detail:
• Sumatran tigers with their keepers.
• Limited seating — be there by 10:45.

blocks.title: Hand-feed the kangaroos (anchor)
blocks.detail:
• Large walk-through enclosure: pat and hand-feed red and grey kangaroos and several kinds of wallaby.
• Feeding runs all day.

blocks.title: Lunch — Crikey! Café
blocks.detail:
• Burgers, pizza, hot chips, sandwiches, salads.
• Watch for birds at the outdoor tables.
blocks.notes:
ESTIMATE — menu prices not published online:
• 2 adult mains ~AUD 20 each
• 2 kids' meals ~AUD 13 each
• = AUD ~66 ≈ USD 43.

blocks.title: Wildlife Warriors Show — Crocoseum, 1:15 PM
blocks.detail:
• The zoo's signature show: birds, snakes and a saltwater crocodile strike at the water's edge.
• Seating is first-come — be seated by 1:00.
• Show length isn't published; ~1 hr allowed.

blocks.title: Koala walk-through — pat a koala
blocks.detail: • On the way back toward the exit.

blocks.title: Drive Australia Zoo → Noosa Junction
blocks.detail:
• Bruce Highway north → Eumundi–Noosa Rd → Noosa.
• ~69 km, ~53 min.

blocks.title: Groceries — Coles or Woolworths, Noosa Junction
blocks.detail:
• Breakfast supplies for six mornings, picnic food, and 6+ L of water for the beach day.
• There are no shops between the ferry and Rainbow Beach.
blocks.notes:
ESTIMATE:
• ~AUD 200 ≈ USD 130 for six breakfasts, a beach-day picnic, snacks and water.

blocks.title: Drive to RACV Noosa Resort
blocks.detail: • 94 Noosa Drive, Noosa Heads.

blocks.title: Check in — RACV Noosa Resort (6 nights)
blocks.detail:
The resort, not the apartment block: heated lagoon pool with sand entry, a second pool with two waterslides, a splash park, playground, games room, school-holiday kids' club (4+), restaurant, tennis.
Two-bedroom apartments with full kitchen and laundry; free parking.
Free shuttle to Hastings St every 30 min, 8 AM–6 PM.
Not walkable to the beach (5-min drive) — that is the trade for resort grounds at roughly two-thirds the Hastings St price.
blocks.flag: Dec 2027 rates and any Christmas-week minimum stay are not published yet. Book ~10–12 months out for availability; confirm check-in time (assumed 3 PM).
blocks.notes:
• Placeholder ~AUD 520/night × 6 = AUD 3,120 ≈ USD 2,028. Published range for standard rooms is AUD 290–756/night; a two-bedroom the week before Christmas will sit in the upper half.
• Versus Seahaven on Hastings St: AUD 630–1,050+/night for a beachfront two-bedroom → AUD 3,750–5,250 for the week.
• Walkable, cheaper alternative if you'd rather be on Hastings St: Mantra French Quarter (lagoon pool, 6-min walk to the beach) — but Dec 2025/2026 reviews cite bugs, thin walls and dark units.
• No Marriott/Hyatt/Hilton property exists in Noosa — cash stay either way.

blocks.title: Drive to Hastings St, park at Noosa Woods
blocks.detail: • 5 min from the resort. Noosa Woods carpark — a 3-min walk to the surf club.

blocks.title: Dinner — Noosa Heads Surf Club
blocks.detail:
Upstairs at the surf lifesaving club, 69 Hastings St, over the patrolled beach.
Fish & chips, steaks, pasta, salads, seafood, kids' menu, sunset table.
Walk-ins only — 5:45 beats the queue.
blocks.notes:
PRICED FROM A MENU LISTING (Aug 2025; the club's own menu is an image):
• Fish & chips AUD 24–28 → 26
• Chicken parmigiana AUD 28–32 → 30
• 2 × kids (nuggets / mini fish & chips / pasta) AUD 12–14 → 13
• = AUD ~82 ≈ USD 53.

blocks.title: Bed
blocks.detail: • Tomorrow's breakfast is 7:30 AM in the apartment → back-at-resort deadline 7:30 PM.

days.title: Noosa — Main Beach, Hastings Street, resort water park

blocks.title: Breakfast in the apartment
blocks.detail: • From last night's groceries.

blocks.title: Drive to Hastings St, park at Noosa Woods
blocks.detail: • 5 min. The Noosa Woods carpark at the river end of Hastings St — arrive early on a December Saturday.

blocks.title: Main Beach, Noosa
blocks.detail:
Noosa Main Beach faces north into Laguna Bay — sheltered from the swell, the calmest patrolled beach on this coast, the one for young kids.
Between the flags in front of the surf club.

blocks.title: Lunch — Betty's Burgers, Hastings Street (the original)
blocks.detail:
Betty's started here before it went national. Order-at-counter burgers, fries, shakes.
Hastings St, a 5-min walk from the surf club.
blocks.notes:
PRICED FROM THE MENU (Sep 2026):
• 2 × Betty's Classic AUD 11.90
• 2 × Kids beef burger AUD 8.90
• = AUD 41.60 ≈ USD 27. Fries excluded.

blocks.title: Hastings St stroll back to the car
blocks.detail: • Shops and gelato along the way.

blocks.title: Water park + lagoon pool
blocks.detail:
• Waterslides, splash park and the sand-entry lagoon pool.
• Retreat to the apartment whenever the kids flag — day 3 of jet lag.

blocks.title: Dinner — restaurant to be chosen
blocks.detail: • Within 15 min of the resort.

blocks.title: Back at the resort — bed by 6:30 PM
blocks.detail: • Tomorrow's breakfast is 6:30 AM for the coastal walk → back-at-resort deadline 6:30 PM.

days.title: Noosa National Park coastal walk + Main Beach

blocks.title: Breakfast in the apartment
blocks.detail: Sunrise is ~4:50 AM in December here (no daylight saving). Early is easy.

blocks.title: Drive to the Noosa National Park entrance
blocks.detail:
Park Rd, Noosa Heads — the national-park day-use carpark.
It fills by 7:30 in December. If it's full, park at Noosa Woods and walk the boardwalk from Hastings St (adds 15 min).

blocks.title: Coastal Walk to Hell's Gates and back (anchor)
blocks.detail:
Boiling Pot lookout (300 m) → Tea Tree Bay → Dolphin Point (1.2 km) → Granite Bay → Hell's Gates (2.7 km one way).
Sealed and easy to Dolphin Point; unsealed with steps and a few steep bits after. 5.4 km return, 3 hrs at a 6-year-old's pace with snack and lookout stops — turn around at Dolphin Point if the little one is done and nothing is lost.
Look up between the entrance and Tea Tree Bay — wild koalas are regularly spotted here.
Fairy Pools (rock pools at Granite Bay): only by scrambling down rocks, only at low tide with small swell. Low tide is 7:05 AM this morning (BOM 2027 prediction) — judge the swell from the track, skip without regret if it's rolling.
blocks.notes:
• Free.
• Beaches inside the park are unpatrolled — no swimming there; the swim is Main Beach afterwards.
• 2 L water, sunscreen; no shade on the Hell's Gates section.

blocks.title: Drive to Hastings St, park at Noosa Woods
Main Beach swim
blocks.detail: Between the flags in front of the surf club.

blocks.title: Lunch — Bistro C, Hastings Street
blocks.detail:
Beachfront, lunch 12–3 PM, bookings taken — book the night before.
Coconut chicken salad, local fish, steak, calamari; kids' menu.
blocks.notes:
NOT VERIFIED — menu published as images:
• 2 adult mains ~AUD 46 each (Hastings St beachfront; reviewers rate it $$–$$$)
• 2 kids' meals ~AUD 18 each (children's menu confirmed by reviewers)
• = AUD ~128 ≈ USD 83.

blocks.title: Resort downtime — heat of the day
blocks.detail: 82–86 °F, humid, storms possible 2–5 PM. Pools when the kids get restless.

blocks.title: Dinner — Noosa Boathouse, Noosaville
blocks.detail:
Three-storey floating restaurant on the river at Gympie Terrace. Bistro downstairs, rooftop bar upstairs; the kids watch the boats from the deck.
Fish & chips, steaks, short rib, lamb gnocchi; a real kids' menu. Book ahead.
blocks.notes:
PRICED FROM THE MENU (July 2026):
• Fish & chips AUD 39
• Slow-braised beef short rib AUD 44
• Kids battered dory & chips AUD 18
• Kids penne bolognese AUD 18
• = AUD 119 ≈ USD 77.

blocks.title: Bed
blocks.detail: Tomorrow's ready time is 8:30 AM → deadline 8:30 PM. On time.

days.title: Main Beach, Hastings Street and the Everglades cruise

blocks.title: Drive to Hastings St, park at Noosa Woods
Main Beach — morning swim
blocks.detail: Between the flags. Lightest wind and fewest people before 11.

blocks.title: Hastings Street — gelato, surf-shop souvenirs
blocks.detail: The village end of the trip. 40 min, then the car.
blocks.notes: • ~AUD 90 for gelato and a couple of small souvenirs ≈ USD 60 (not a meal — not part of the dining audit).

blocks.title: Lunch — Dazza's Bar & Bistro, RACV (quick)
blocks.detail: Second visit, on purpose: it's on the way out the door and the kids know the menu. Burgers and the kids' menu.
blocks.notes:
PRICED FROM THE MENU:
• Dazza's beefburger AUD 30
• Spaghetti bolognese AUD 28
• 2 × kids' meals AUD 16
• = AUD 90 ≈ USD 59.

blocks.title: Drive to Habitat Noosa, Boreen Point
blocks.detail:
McKinnon Dr → Louis Bazzo Dr → Lake Flat Rd, 204 Lake Flat Rd. ~30 km, 35 min.
Self-drive rather than the 1 PM courtesy shuttle — the shuttle's pickup points aren't published and the drive is shorter than the shuttle loop. Be there by 1:30 for a 2 PM departure.

blocks.title: Check in at Habitat Noosa, bathroom, boarding
Noosa Everglades Serenity Cruise (anchor)
blocks.detail:
One of only two everglades systems on earth: across Lake Cootharaba and up the tea-coloured, glass-flat upper Noosa River, where the reflections are the show.
Skipper commentary, wildlife (sea eagles, kingfishers, turtles), a drink included. ~2¾ hrs on a roofed boat — nothing to drive, nothing to rent.
blocks.notes:
• AUD 94 per adult; child (2–11) price not listed online — assume ~AUD 70 → ~AUD 330 ≈ USD 215. Free cancellation to 48 hrs.
• If a boat is a no: TreeTop Challenge at the Big Pineapple (Woombye, 45 min) — high-ropes courses with a junior course for 6+, outdoors, ~AUD 40–60 per person.
• Runs daily 2:00–~5:00 PM (re-checked Oct 2026). Adult AUD 99 (Apr 2026–Mar 2027); child price 'please enquire' — budget above may run slightly low.

blocks.title: Drive back to the resort
blocks.detail: 35 min plus getting off the boat and to the car.

blocks.title: Shower, change, drive to Sunshine Beach
blocks.detail: 10 min around the headland.

blocks.title: Dinner — Sunshine Beach Surf Club
blocks.detail:
On the dunes above Sunshine Beach with the whole ocean in front.
Fish, steaks, burgers, pasta, kids' meals — a different beach and a different view from Noosa's club. Bookings taken.
blocks.notes:
PRICED FROM THE MENU (Winter 2024 — expect ~10% more by 2027):
• Chicken parmy, salad, chips AUD 28
• Battered snapper, chips, slaw AUD 27.50
• Kids fish 'n' chips AUD 13.50
• Kids chicken nuggets AUD 13.50 (kids' meals include ice cream)
• = AUD 82.50 ≈ USD 54.

days.title: Noosa Spit, the river ferry, water park — 4WD delivered tonight

blocks.title: Breakfast in the apartment
blocks.detail: The first lie-in of the week — deliberately light day before the 5:30 AM beach start tomorrow.

blocks.title: Drive to Noosa Spit (Claude Batten Drive)
blocks.detail: Park at the Noosa Woods / Spit carpark at the river end of Hastings St.

blocks.title: Noosa Spit — the river-mouth sand flats
blocks.detail:
Where the Noosa River meets Laguna Bay: calm, warm, ankle-to-waist-deep water over sandbars, tiny fish, soldier crabs, no surf.
The best free kids' morning in Noosa. Shade under the casuarinas on the river side.
Stay on the river side of the spit; the ocean side is unpatrolled.

blocks.title: Change, walk to the Hastings St ferry jetty
blocks.detail: Noosa Ferry jetty at the river end of Hastings St (Elysium / Noosa Sound stop), 5-min walk. Car stays at the Woods.

blocks.title: Noosa Ferry → Noosaville (Yacht Club stop)
blocks.detail:
The hop-on hop-off river ferry — slow, open-sided, past the canals and the houseboats. ~30 min plus waiting; kids sit on the bow.
Cheap, no booking. Check the timetable the night before — services are roughly hourly.
blocks.notes: • All-day family pass ~AUD 70 ≈ USD 45 (confirm current fares).

blocks.title: Lunch — Noosa Yacht & Rowing Club, Noosaville
blocks.detail:
The sailing club's bistro on the river at Chaplin Park, 142 Gympie Terrace — the ferry stops right at it.
Club prices, big deck over the water, dinghies coming and going, kids' meals. No bookings needed at lunch.
blocks.notes:
PARTLY VERIFIED (reviewer prices; menu PDF not readable online):
• Burger AUD 25
• Barramundi mid-AUD 30s → 35
• 2 kids' meals ~AUD 14 each
• = AUD ~88 ≈ USD 57.

blocks.title: Ferry back to Hastings St, walk to the car
blocks.detail: ~30 min ride plus waiting for the next boat; 5-min walk to the Woods carpark.

blocks.title: Water park + lagoon pool
blocks.detail: The resort afternoon. Storms are most likely 2–5 PM — the pools are the easiest place to be when one rolls through.

blocks.title: Buy the Cooloola permit; check tomorrow's conditions
blocks.detail:
Cooloola vehicle access permit for Dec 22 online (AUD 15.40 for the calendar day, plate-recognised, nothing to display) — you'll need the 4WD's plate number from the operator.
Check the QPWS Cooloola conditions report and the ferry's timetable/tide page.
Pack the beach bags: 6 L water, picnic breakfast and lunch, sunscreen, hats, rash shirts, towels, dry bag, sand shoes.

blocks.title: 4WD delivered to the resort — handover and beach briefing
blocks.detail:
Noosa 2 Fraser / Noosa2K'gari 4WD Hire (Richard, Pomona/Doonan yard) delivers a Prado/Pajero-class 4WD to the RACV carpark for a one-day hire: tonight's handover, tomorrow's drive, collected here tomorrow evening or Thursday morning.
30-min briefing: tyre pressures (they supply gauge, compressor and recovery kit), the tide chart, where the Third Cutting is, 80 km/h beach / 40 km/h camping-zone limits, Mudlo Rocks, no night driving.
Move the booster seat across from the rental. Load the beach bags tonight.
blocks.flag: Book by email (info@noosa2fraser.com.au) and get the delivery-to-RACV, the evening handover, the Thursday-morning collection and the one-day price confirmed in writing — their default meeting point is the Tewantin ferry carpark, and evening pickups/hotel drops are something reviewers describe him doing, not a published service.
blocks.notes:
COST:
• Day hire AUD 225 (BookMe listing; confirm direct)
• Excess reduction AUD 29 (AUD 5,000 excess → AUD 1,800)
• Cooloola permit AUD 15.40 (on the logistics block)
• Ferry one way AUD 15
• = AUD ~284 ≈ USD 185 — plus fuel on the drive block.

WHY THIS OPERATOR:
• Reviewers report exactly this shape of hire: 'picked up the 4WD the night before, drove to Rainbow Beach and back along 40 km of beach'; 'offered to hand over the car the very same evening so we could head up the beach early'; a car left at the airport on request.
• Pomona/Doonan is 20 min from the resort, so delivery is a short hop for him.

BACKUPS:
• Drop Bear Adventures, 3 Sanders St, Noosaville (10 min away) — LandCruisers with permit and recovery gear included, but they push multi-day hires.
• East Coast 4WD Hire (Prado, AUD 395/day).
• Guided: Great Beach Drive 4WD Tours, 8-hr day with lunch, ferry and permits, max 6 guests — the no-driving fallback.

DRIVER: 30–75 years old, 3+ years on a full licence; a US licence is fine — carry it.

blocks.title: Dinner in the apartment
blocks.detail: Kitchen night — something easy from Sunday's shop. Early and quiet on purpose.

blocks.title: Bed — lights out 7:30 PM
blocks.detail: Tomorrow's ready time is 5:45 AM → deadline 5:45 PM. This runs ~1 hr over for the one early start of the week; 9.5 hrs of sleep and a slow Thursday after it.

days.title: 4WD day — Teewah Beach, the Double Island Point lagoon, Rainbow Beach

blocks.title: Up, quick breakfast, into the 4WD
blocks.detail: Light by 4:50. Cereal and fruit in the apartment; picnic and water already in the car. 35 min because it's two kids at 5 AM.

blocks.title: Drive to the Noosa North Shore Ferry, Tewantin
blocks.detail: Noosa Drive → Noosa Parade → Gympie Terrace → Moorindil St. ~10 km, 20 min, plus 5 for the queue lane.

blocks.title: Car ferry across the Noosa River
blocks.detail:
Cable ferry, every ~10 min, from 5:30 AM. The crossing is 5 min; the pre-Christmas queue can be 15–25 min — that's what the 25-min block is.
Pay on board by card, or a QR ticket bought online.
blocks.notes: • AUD 15 one way per car. One crossing today — the return is inland.

blocks.title: Onto the beach — the Third Cutting
blocks.detail:
Off the ferry: 2.2 km Maximillian Rd → right onto Beach Rd, 2.1 km of bitumen → the marked third sand cutting (the only legal entry).
At the top of the cutting: tyres down to ~18 psi, 4WD engaged. Bathroom stop for the kids at the Noosa North Shore campground on the way past.
First 3 km past the camping area is 40 km/h.

blocks.title: Teewah Beach north — 40 km on the sand
blocks.detail:
The beach is the road: firm sand below the high-water line, 80 km/h limit, 40 km/h past the camping zones, pedestrians and anglers own the beach.
Teewah village and the coloured cliffs slide past on the left.
One 15-min stop at the Red Canyon (red-sand gully in the cliffs, ~35 km up) — the kids can run up it.
blocks.notes:
TIDE — official Bureau of Meteorology 2027 predictions, Noosa Head standard port (AEST, LAT datum):
• Wed Dec 22: high 3:45 AM 1.65 m → LOW 9:43 AM 0.82 m → high 3:24 PM 1.55 m → low 9:54 PM.
• Range 0.73 m — a neap (new moon Dec 27). Beach drivable roughly 7:15 AM–12:15 PM (low ±2½ hrs); QPWS rule is never within 2 hrs of high water.
• The other candidates: Tue Dec 21 low 8:24 AM (0.77 m); Thu Dec 23 low 10:58 AM (0.82 m). Dec 22 is the latest start that still clears Rainbow Beach before noon.
• Double Island Point sits ~55 km north of the Noosa Head gauge on the same open coast — same tide within minutes.
• Source: BOM tide predictions 2027 via ausmarinescience.com (Noosa Head; Mooloolaba cross-checked: low 9:43 AM both).

blocks.title: Leisha Track — over the headland to the lagoon
blocks.detail:
At the base of Double Island Point the beach ends. The Leisha Track is a short sand track across the back of the headland to the north (Rainbow Beach) side.
The lagoon is 400 m from the track's northern end.

blocks.title: Double Island Point lagoon — 2 hours (anchor)
blocks.detail:
The turquoise lagoon behind the sand spit on the north side of the point.
Sheltered from the wind and the swell; calm, clear, shallow. Fish, soldier crabs in their thousands at low tide, turtles and dolphins in the channel.
Low tide is 9:43 AM (BOM 2027 prediction), right in the middle of this block — the lagoon at its shallowest and warmest, refilling as the tide turns.
Wading, swimming, picnic on the spit. Unpatrolled — an adult in the water with the kids, and stay in the shallows, not the channel mouth.
Honeymoon Bay (the calm cove on the point itself) is 5 min back if the lagoon is busy.
blocks.notes:
• No facilities at the point — toilets are at the Freshwater day-use area 5 km south (a 10-min detour on the way up if needed).
• The lighthouse walk (800 m from the north side, steep) is a skip — the lagoon is the point.

If the rocks are covered: turn back to the Leisha Track, take the Freshwater Track inland to Rainbow Beach Rd (+45 min).

360° views: Rainbow Beach, Inskip Point, Tin Can Bay, K'gari on the horizon.
This is the dunes piece of Fraser — run, roll, slide down the leeward face. Shoes on, the sand is hot by now; 20 min up, 25 on top, 15 down.
